name: 52-Week High Forward Returns
description: Analyzes forward 21-day (1-month) returns after SPY makes a new 52-week high. Compares post-breakout return distribution to unconditional (all-day) returns. Includes histogram of post-high returns, scatter of forward return vs trailing 1Y percentile rank, event markers for each new high, and summary statistics table.
source:
# 52-Week High Forward Returns Analysis
# Question: Does buying at new 52-week highs lead to continuation or mean reversion?
# Method: Detect 260-bar highs, measure 21-day forward returns, compare to unconditional baseline

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
high = src.h
ts = index().value

# --- 52-Week High Detection ---
# highestbars returns 0 when current bar IS the highest in the lookback
bars_since_high = highestbars(period=260)(high)
is_new_high = bars_since_high == 0

# --- Forward Returns (21 trading days ≈ 1 month) ---
fwd_21d = forward_returns(period=21)(close)

# Post-new-high forward returns (sparse — only on event days)
nh_fwd_21d = where(is_new_high, fwd_21d)

# --- Context: Where in the range is price? ---
# Percentile rank of close over 1 year — shows if high is early-cycle or late-cycle
price_pctrank = percentrank(period=260)(close)
nh_pctrank = where(is_new_high, price_pctrank)

# --- Hit rate computation (ternary for correct aggregation) ---
# New-high hit rate: 1 if positive, 0 if not (NaN-guarded)
nh_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(nh_fwd_21d) and nh_fwd_21d > 0) else 0.0 if is_valid(nh_fwd_21d) else nh_fwd_21d

# Unconditional hit rate
all_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_21d) and fwd_21d > 0) else 0.0 if is_valid(fwd_21d) else fwd_21d

# --- Event count ---
nh_count = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(1.0 if is_new_high else 0.0)

# --- Output 1: Histogram of post-new-high forward returns ---
histogram(
    title='Do New Highs Lead to More Gains or Reversals?',
    category='52-Week High Analysis',
    bins=30,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.7,
    show_analytics=True,
    x_axis_label='Forward 21-Day Return',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(nh_fwd_21d)

# --- Output 2: Scatter — forward return vs price percentile rank ---
# Shows whether early-cycle highs (lower pctrank) behave differently than late-cycle
xy_scatter(
    title='Does Timing Within the Rally Matter?',
    category='52-Week High Analysis',
    x_axis_label='Price Percentile Rank (260d)',
    y_axis_label='Forward 21-Day Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_axis_dp=0,
    show_trend_line=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero Return')
    ]),
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='New 52-Week High', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    order=2
)(nh_pctrank, nh_fwd_21d)

# --- Output 3: Summary Table — New High vs Unconditional ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='New 52-Week High vs All Days (21-Day Forward Returns)',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['New 52-Wk High', 'All Days (Baseline)'],
        col_headers=['Event Count', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate (% Positive)', 'Best Return', 'Worst Return'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='52-Week High Analysis',
    order=3
)(nh_count, nh_fwd_21d, nh_hit, nh_fwd_21d, nh_fwd_21d, fwd_21d, fwd_21d, all_hit, fwd_21d, fwd_21d)

# --- Output 4: Event Markers — each new 52-week high ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='New 52-Week High',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Fwd 21d Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Close Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Price Pctile (1Y)', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(fwd_21d, close, price_pctrank, is_new_high)
